architecture.overview: Modular Bicep files deployed at subscription scope. Each service has its own module. The Container App Environment module creates the shared Log Analytics workspace used for unified observability across all Container Apps. The arch-content-foundry module provisions an OpenAI resource with a GPT-4o deployment for the arch-content-update CI workflow. The gpt-5.3-codex model for ideas-bot is deployed independently to avoid quota-related deployment failures impacting the rest of the infrastructure. The history-api module introduces a Go-based Azure Function app running on a Flex Consumption plan, with EasyAuth integration and dedicated storage resources for versions table and history-attachments blob container. The posts-api module now integrates with history-api via HISTORY_API_URL and HISTORY_API_KEY app settings, enabling version history and storage functionality.

sections.content: The Azure infrastructure is defined using modular Bicep files deployed at subscription scope. Each service has its own module. The Container App Environment module creates the shared Log Analytics workspace used for unified observability across all Container Apps. The arch-content-foundry module provisions an OpenAI resource with a GPT-4o deployment for the arch-content-update CI workflow. The gpt-5.3-codex model for ideas-bot is deployed independently to avoid quota-related deployment failures impacting the rest of the infrastructure. Additionally, Azure Table Storage is provisioned and utilized by ideas-api for project resolution and backfill operations, ensuring robust data consistency and integrity for project and idea management workflows. Posts-api integrates with history-api for version-history storage, requiring HISTORY_API_URL and HISTORY_API_KEY environment variables to enable secure communication.
